input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
input.rationale: The cap is mutual and the carve-outs in § 21.3 (confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) plus the payment-obligation exclusion match the playbook. However the cap basis is illusory: "Fees" is defined in § 1.5/1.6 as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee stated in the first Order Form, and § 21.1 further narrows the basis to the first Order Form only, so Vendor's aggregate exposure is capped near USD 12,000 regardless of subscription spend. There is also no USD 1,000,000 floor. Redline ties the cap to all amounts paid or payable by Customer under the Agreement and all Order Forms in the preceding twelve months, with a USD 1,000,000 floor, leaving the existing mutuality and Excluded Claims structure intact.

proposal.summary: Fix illusory cap basis in § 21.1: all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement (not the USD 12,000 "Fees" under the first Order Form), with a USD 1,000,000 floor.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] As drafted the mutual cap is illusory: "Fees" is defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so Vendor's exposure is a fraction of contract value. We tie the cap to all amounts paid or payable by Customer in the preceding twelve months with a USD 1,000,000 floor; indemnification, confidentiality, data-protection and security claims remain outside the cap as Excluded Claims. If the floor is not acceptable, we can fall back to twelve months' total amounts payable.

ops.oldText: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
ops.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000.
